journal_lines: Dug because of the smell of iron. Was right.
Something buried here. The soil was wrong over it. Investigated.
Old chest in the sand. Waterlogged. Still had things in it.
The sand was compacted differently. Dug two feet and found it.
Corroded hinges but the contents were sealed. Old work.
Buried at high-tide line. Old hiding place. Found it.
The barnacles told me it had been here longer than the town nearby.
Wax seal on the interior chest. Intact. The contents dry.
The weight of the sand above it was a hint. The iron smell confirmed it.
Disturbed earth that everyone else walked over. Everyone else was wrong.
Someone buried this carefully. Someone else is finding it now.
Found two feet down. The ocean had preserved it better than expected.
